operations.rationale: Replace the command-contract validation-state table with reader prose while preserving the canonical AI/research state matrix. October 11 displayed-view reconciliation preserves current grants, affected-action holds and distinct planning/admission/observation phases.
content_lines: Command contracts move through pre-execution validation states. A draft or field-complete contract can be reviewed while its interpretation and requirements remain unresolved. Confirmed field presence alone supplies neither current authority nor evidence of a completed effect.

Conflicts need an accountable interpretation or policy decision. Inferred means cannot create permission, but an independently valid existing grant may already cover a proposed action. Hold the affected effect when its requirements are missing or unsatisfied; authorized planning, preparation or a narrower local route may continue.

Validated for planning means the contract can become planning input. Runtime admission still requires current authority and the applicable preconditions. A superseded contract retains its identity and permitted history; current reuse needs a separate eligibility decision.
These states distinguish usable planning input from dispatch permission and actual outcomes. They do not establish correct interpretation, enforcement, observed effects or delivery.

operations.rationale: Turn the command-contract field and field-status tables into reader prose without changing the canonical interface vocabulary. October 11 displayed-view reconciliation separates declared obligations, current admission, scoped observation, permitted history and independent evidence/release decisions.
content_lines: The command contract joins the accepted objective, non-goals, constraints, allowed means, current authority references, criteria, stops and recovery duties. These fields describe obligations for consumers; recording them does not enforce the boundary or prove an effect.

Human Intent owns interpretation and acceptance. Planning proposes work order, Compilation owns lowering, and Labor OS owns job lifecycle. Authority, Runtime and Security own current effect admission; identified observers report outcomes and their coverage. Artifacts retain permitted lineage. Verification evaluates criteria, while Evidence States and release owners make their separate decisions. Planning or a complete receipt cannot make those decisions for them.

Field status explains why a value is available. Confirmed values may support planning; policy can constrain but cannot silently broaden authority. Source-derived context retains its source limits. A default needs a scope and trigger, and may resolve an independently valid grant reference; neither a default nor an inference creates permission. Missing information holds only the affected use when a narrower interpretation can preserve the accepted obligations.

Each receipt needs a producer, coverage and trust dependencies. An accepted interpretation, planning-ready contract, current grant, job dispatch, attempted effect, observed outcome, useful delivery, recovery, support transition and release are distinct. Keep uncertainty and residuals visible, and retain only the history and payloads allowed by their privacy and rights rules.
